test_title: PYST 49: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7df456a9c2680052e0294eb481d98c1bcb06b52e387e90c75ac5438a8d310537.png] 

The logic followed here is based on the alphabetical position pattern:

Option 1: UY - TX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56dbc278d3c4c66e4453cda8cd5f1abfee448928b961f5fb1a41f8e9030724c3.png] 

Option 2: GK - FJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b98e3cc8961691bf39ec587da3f948ef02926af30d468a233cb0fd78e117380.png] 

Option 3: RV - QV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d256ea20bb98156db120fbfbae3ae2b74dde062763ccca6a633557f7bed2e0b.png] 

Option 4: LP - KO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b908a79677fc1abb7a536eab27c5882995663cae5d5e171fcb6ddc6cde0464c4.png] 

Thus, RV - QV does not follow the pattern.

Hence, the odd one out is **Option 3.**
